protocol.selection: Algorithm and candidate family fixed theoretically; no qualification-based tuning.
supplied_information: true omission rule in oracle mode only

language.scope: Previous development and opened qualification authors now training; no V3qualification author used.

protocol.message_length_prior: P(N=n)=(1/128)*(127/128)^n, n>=0; true evaluation length not supplied
protocol.rule_selection: maximize exact forward marginal likelihood on a separate 512-letter encoded calibration message; selected once per rule/fixture; unchanged on evaluation/controls
protocol.control_policy: Preserve exact code multiset. Preserve per-token omission flags when independent of context, hence raw length. For previous_mod3 reserialize the shuffled codes under the true context rule; length may change.
protocol.baseline: uniform-letter language, true key/emissions and true omission rule
protocol.application_gate: A passing conditional parser is not an unknown-key solver. No game key search or translation claim authorized by this gate alone.
limits: Known true key and code emission distribution are strong oracle advantages, unavailable for real469.
Four rule scenarios and order controls share each of60source excerpts/keys; do not pool as independent plaintexts.
Only two fresh authors; short finite samples and a small explicitly defined rule family.
Forward probability and MAP posterior are conditional on the approximate character model, not semantic truth.
Controls have known valid encryption/zero rules but disrupted order; not every permuted passage is guaranteed meaningless.
Synthetic99-code keys use all00..99 except39 to match inventory size; this is not evidence that the imported469stream is correct.
